items.headline: Dorgu returns to Manchester with hamstring injury from Denmark duty
items.summary: Patrick Dorgu forced off after 30 minutes in Denmark's 2-0 Nations League win over Wales with suspected hamstring injury. Sent back for further assessment.

items.headline: Dorgu hamstring injury adds to Man United's deepening medical crisis
items.summary: Dorgu undergoing tests at Carrington after first-half exit. Availability for Tottenham clash Oct 10 now uncertain; Luke Shaw likely to continue at left-back.

items.headline: Bruno Fernandes and Patrick Dorgu face fitness checks after international duty
items.summary: United face dual injury concern with Dorgu sidelined by hamstring injury and Fernandes dealing with fitness issues during international break.
